caption: This drawing depicts a lidded tankard with a large, curved handle. The tankard is cylindrical with a slightly flaring base and a domed lid that features a decorative thumb piece. The handle is ornate, featuring detailed embellishments along its length and curves from the top of the tankard down and outward before attaching to the body near the base. There are two inset drawings: the top left inset shows a close-up of the handle's upper section with its detailed thumb piece, and the bottom right inset provides a small schematic side view of the entire tankard with measurements. The overall composition is rendered in monochrome, likely graphite on paper, and is set within a rectangular frame on a lightly textured background. The main image is centrally placed while the insets are positioned in the upper left and lower right corners.
title: Silver Tankard
